intent: Close the pristine-host predispatch deadlock by making SADHANA NoEffect preparation publish and replay-validate one exact private initial mission projection. Bind it to the prepared config, paused session, generation, task set, held-out manifest, and an explicit admitted projection path while preserving a globally empty dispatch/effect census. The projection is observer bootstrap evidence only: it grants no dispatch authority, performs no provider call, and cannot substitute for later owner execution or acceptance evidence.

negative_controls.name: projection-path-config-and-replay-hostiles
negative_controls.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_sadhana_prepare_runtime.py -k 'projection and (path or config or replay or crash)'

interface_mismatches: The observer API requires an accepted projection before dispatch, while the real supervisor is correctly forbidden until dispatch authority exists; preparation must therefore publish a private paused initial projection without running provider dispatch.

A filesystem projection publication is internal bootstrap evidence, not a provider, tool, lease, dispatch, verifier, acceptance, or public publication effect; global runtime effect rows must remain empty before and after.
The projection path is a deployment-owned authority boundary and must be an explicit absolute input bound into the preparation receipt rather than an ambient default.
honest_blockers: This packet alone does not change release systemd or environment wiring; the final direct-child release must pass the exact projection path and grant only its required private write root.
The prepared projection proves a paused coherent bootstrap view only; it cannot claim useful work, provider reachability, acceptance, mobile reachability, or dispatch authority.
No external service, VPS, provider, public route, release seal, or Git remote may be mutated by this packet.
session_entry.rollback: Stop SADHANA dispatch, remove the final release wiring, and revert the prepared-projection publication and its replay validators as one unit. Never restore a predispatch topology in which observer health waits on a supervisor that authority correctly forbids from starting.
